headline: Spiro Uganda Plans Triple Battery-Swapping Hub Expansion by December
summary: Spiro Uganda plans to triple its mega battery-swapping hubs by December 2026 amid growing demand for electric motorcycles and new EV infrastructure rules.
why: Expanding charging and swapping networks is essential for scaling electric mobility adoption in developing urban transport markets.

impacts.name: Electric Vehicles
impacts.why: Infrastructure expansion supports higher adoption rates for electric motorcycles and related services.
